title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: provide opinionated RAG agent templates and small tool-calling quickstarts so engineers can prototype retrieval-augmented agents and integrations faster. This PR adds: 1) a set of RAG agent templates (customer-support, knowledge-bot, sales-assistant) with recommended prompt formats and config; 2) two tool-calling quickstarts (Python and TypeScript) demonstrating file/HTTP/database tools wired to agents; 3) docs site updates (new guide pages, sidebar entries, and images) and a short migration note for existing agent users. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates under redwood-examples - [x] Add Python + TS quickstart samples - [x] Update redwood-docs guide and sidebar - [x] Add tests for examples smoke-run - [x] Run CI and fix linting - [x] Add release notes and changelog entry Notes: kept runtime changes to zero — templates reference existing runtime APIs and example configs only. Kept example code minimal and well-documented for copy/paste. Related: ENG-4201 (template infra), DOCS-312 (docs guide), EX-61 (examples backlog).
